items.title: 30.5 Kisi molecule ka 1H NMR spectrum predict karna (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 30.5 with Example 30.1 and Quick Check 30.5 answered (PDF 210). Answers need review.

blocks.text: Chemical environment, chemical shift aur peaks ke batne ko samajhne ke baad kisi bhi molecule ka structure dekh kar us ka ¹H NMR spectrum predict (pehle se andaza) kiya ja sakta hai. Yeh in steps mein hota hai:
Step I: Molecule mein protons ke mukhtalif environments pehchanein.

blocks.latex: \text{Number of different environments} = \text{Number of peaks expected in spectrum}
blocks.text_alt: Number of different environments = Number of peaks expected in spectrum

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Yani jitne mukhtalif environments, spectrum mein utni hi peaks ki tawaqqo (expectation) rakhein.

Step II: Aik jaise environment wale protons ke har set ki chemical shift (δ) data table (Table 30.1) ki ranges se andaza karein. Agar table na ho to qareeb ke bonds aur atoms dekhein: electronegative elements ke qareeb protons ki chemical shift (δ) zyada hoti hai, aur alkyl groups wale protons ki aam taur par kam.
Step III: 'n+1' rule laga kar har peak ke batne ka namoona (splitting pattern) batayein.
Step IV: Har environment ke hydrogen atoms ki tadaad ke mutabiq peaks ke areas ka ratio (integration ratio) likhein.

blocks.title: Misal 30.1
blocks.problem: Chloroethane (CH₃-CH₂-Cl) ka ¹H NMR spectrum predict karein.
steps: Peaks ki tadaad: molecule mein do mukhtalif chemical environments hain (CH₃ aur CH₂).
Is liye chloroethane ke ¹H NMR spectrum mein peaks = 2.
Chemical shift: -CH₂- electronegative element (Cl) se jura hai, is liye us ki chemical shift zyada hogi (3.0 – 4.5 ppm). Methyl protons ki chemical shift kam hogi (0.5 – 1.5 ppm).
Batna: -CH₃ ke sub-peaks = 2 + 1 = 3, kyunke -CH₃ ke saath wale carbon par 2 protons hain.
Is liye -CH₃ ka signal triplet ban jayega.
-CH₂- ke sub-peaks = 3 + 1 = 4, kyunke -CH₂- ke saath wale carbon par 3 protons hain.
Is liye -CH₂- ka signal quartet ban jayega.
blocks.answer: Peaks ke areas: -CH₃ aur -CH₂- ka ratio 3:2 hoga.

blocks.prompt: Compound (CH₃)₂CHOH ke liye batayein: a) peaks ki tadaad, b) proton ki qism aur chemical shift, c) peaks ke nisbati areas, d) batne ka namoona.
blocks.explanation: a) Teen. b) Do barabar CH₃ groups (alkyl, 0.5 – 1.5 ppm); O ke saath CH (3.0 – 4.5 ppm); OH (0.5 – 6.0 ppm). c) 6:1:1. d) CH₃: doublet (1 parosi H); CH: saat sub-peaks (6 parosi H; OH aam taur par nahi baant'ta); OH: singlet.

items: Environments gin kar peaks ginein (Step I).
Table 30.1 se chemical shift (Step II); n + 1 rule se batna (Step III); H ki tadaad se areas (Step IV).
Chloroethane: CH₃ triplet 0.5 – 1.5 ppm, CH₂ quartet 3.0 – 4.5 ppm, areas 3:2.
